name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl

instructions.description: Lie on your back with heels resting on a stability ball and arms by your sides.
Lift your hips into a bridge so the body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Bend your knees and roll the ball toward your hips while keeping the pelvis lifted.
Extend the legs slowly and lower the hips with control after the set.

performanceMetrics.notes: Maintain pelvic control throughout the curl.

variations.variationDescription: A more demanding posterior-chain progression that adds knee flexion on an unstable surface.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Hold the bridge without curling the ball to reduce difficulty.

commentsNotes: Do not let the hips sag during the curl.
Move slowly to control the ball.
